brief.rules: Provider is Claude Code Cloud; never substitute a same-VM subagent for a cloud worker. Build only your phase; later phases' features stay out. Make no change that risks reliable playout: with the OBS scenes switch off, everything behaves as today. Rename nothing persisted (src/model/AGENTS.md). Phases touching src/output/ or the publish code follow the spec's contract with the live-publishing run; merge origin/main right before landing and never work around its design. A migration only in a quiet window (supabase/AGENTS.md) and never while the landing hold is on. OBS hardware results come only from the owner phases; a builder or checker never counts one as passed. A behaviour choice the spec does not settle goes to the owner as one question through the coordinator. Never weaken, skip or loosen a test, check, limit or budget, and never write a test-maintenance entry or budget exception to pass a gate. Workers do not attach or read the private repository. Public text names no event, date, site or person, and uses no em dashes. Evidence for each phase goes in docs/work-specs/obs-scenes/evidence/phase-<id>.md. Keep receipts and messages short. The production_copies switch is ON in production and stays on; if anything a phase sees looks wrong because of it, tell the coordinator at once.
